```yaml
name: Check Devin PR Assignee

on:
  pull_request_target:
    branches:
      - main
    types:
      - labeled

jobs:
  check-assignee:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Check assignee
        id: check_assignee
        run: |
          ASSIGNEE=$(gh pr view ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --json assignees --jq '.[0].login')
          if [[ "$ASSIGNEE" != "devin" ]]; then
            echo "::error::PR must be assigned to @devin"
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run tests
        if: ${{ success() }}
        run: npm test

      - name: Lint code
        if: ${{ success() }}
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Build documentation
        if: ${{ success() }}
        run: npm run build:docs

      - name: Deploy documentation
        if: ${{ success() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
        run: npm run deploy:docs
        env:
          DOCKER_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}
          DOCKER_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
```
